## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the problem, its trigger, and what changes for users. Link an issue if relevant.

## Validation

List the checks you actually ran and their results. For UI changes, attach screenshots and label sample data versus native/SSH evidence. For documentation-only changes, check links and examples.

## Relevant boundaries

- [ ] Manual host trust, personal-space privacy and task-space isolation are preserved where relevant.
- [ ] Agent writes pass lease checks; unknown remote outcomes are not silently replayed.
- [ ] Documentation and Skill match the interface; compatibility changes are described.
- [ ] Logs, fixtures and attachments contain no credentials or private server data.

Mark an item only when it applies and has been checked. Explain migrations, limitations or follow-up work that affects review.
